title: Selecting sidemen: Waymon Reid
summary: He finds sidemen through recommendations; Waymon Reid joined because of the band's top arrangers.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Do you go -- How do you get these sidemen? Do you go looking for them or how do you select them?

Well, in many cases I went to places and listen to a fellow or recommend by somebody that is qualified to recommend a musician; like for instance, I have a trumpet player now and he recommend another trumpet player. I mean, if he is really a trumpet player, he is going to recommend the one as good as he.
How did you get Waymon ReId?

Well, because Waymon ReId liked good music and good book. Wayman ReId's been playing with the best bands including one of the finest, Count Ba^sie. So he know what we had in our group. He know that Chico O'Farrill arranged for us. Rene Hernandez people, they had arranged too, because he played Chico O'Farrill arrangement with Count Ba^sie. So he just - is something that you have to figure it out yourself.- Okay, I am going to play with such a band that had top-flight arrangement, I am going to enjoy it and I am going to be in company of so and so, and so and so, and so- because is a mouth to mouth thing.
